boss_clears_ratio_shares.name: boss_clears_ratio_shares
boss_clears_ratio_shares.value: ("boss_clears"."split_mode" = 'ratio') = ("boss_clears"."my_share" IS NOT NULL AND "boss_clears"."shares_total" IS NOT NULL)

nexon_accounts_credential_matches_source.name: nexon_accounts_credential_matches_source
nexon_accounts_credential_matches_source.value:
("nexon_accounts"."identity_source" = 'login' AND "nexon_accounts"."nexon_uid" IS NOT NULL AND "nexon_accounts"."api_key_hash" IS NULL)
        OR ("nexon_accounts"."identity_source" = 'key' AND "nexon_accounts"."api_key_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "nexon_accounts"."nexon_uid" IS NULL)

notices_scheduled_at_idx.name: notices_scheduled_at_idx
notices_scheduled_at_idx.where: "notices"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notices"."sent_at" IS NULL
